segments.source: <emphasis effect="bold">Using Excel:</emphasis> To calculate the slope and <emphasis effect="italics">y</emphasis>-intercept of the linear model, start by entering the (<emphasis effect="italics">x, y</emphasis>) data in two columns in Excel.

segments.source: Then the Excel commands =SLOPE and =INTERCEPT can be used to calculate the slope and intercept, respectively.
segments.translation: 그런 다음 Excel 명령어 =SLOPE와 =INTERCEPT를 사용하여 각각 기울기와 절편을 계산할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Interpret and Apply the Slope and <emphasis effect="italics">y</emphasis>-Intercept
The slope of the line, <emphasis effect="italics">b</emphasis>, describes how changes in the variables are related.
segments.translation: 직선의 기울기 <emphasis effect="italics">b</emphasis>는 변수들의 변화가 서로 어떻게 관련되어 있는지를 나타냅니다.

segments.source: It is important to interpret the slope of the line in the context of the situation represented by the data.
segments.translation: 직선의 기울기는 데이터가 나타내는 상황의 맥락에서 해석하는 것이 중요합니다.

segments.source: You should be able to write a sentence interpreting the slope in plain English.
segments.translation: 기울기를 해석하는 문장을 쉬운 말로 쓸 수 있어야 합니다.

segments.source: The slope of the best-fit line tells us how the dependent variable (<emphasis effect="italics">y</emphasis>) changes for every one unit increase in the independent (<emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis>) variable, on average.
segments.translation: 최적적합선의 기울기는 독립(<emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis>)변수가 한 단위 증가할 때마다 종속변수(<emphasis effect="italics">y</emphasis>)가 평균적으로 얼마나 변하는지를 알려 줍니다.

segments.source: In the previous example, the linear regression model for the monthly amount spent on advertising and the monthly revenue for a Fortune 500 company for 12 months was generated as follows:
segments.translation: 앞의 예제에서 한 Fortune 500 기업의 12개월간 월별 광고비 지출액과 월별 매출액에 대한 선형 회귀 모형은 다음과 같이 도출되었습니다.

segments.source: Since the slope was determined to be 61.8, the company can interpret this to mean that for every $1,000 dollars spent on advertising, on average, this will result in an increase in revenues of $61,800.
segments.translation: 기울기가 61.8로 구해졌으므로, 이 기업은 광고비로 1,000달러를 지출할 때마다 평균적으로 매출이 61,800달러 증가한다는 의미로 이를 해석할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: The intercept of the regression equation is the corresponding <emphasis effect="italics">y</emphasis>-value when the <emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis>-value (independent variable) is equal to zero.
segments.translation: 회귀방정식의 절편은 <emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis>값(독립변수)이 0일 때 그에 대응하는 <emphasis effect="italics">y</emphasis>값입니다.

segments.source: The intercept of the best-fit line tells us the expected mean value of <emphasis effect="italics">y</emphasis> in the case where the <emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis>-variable is equal to zero.
segments.translation: 최적적합선의 절편은 <emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis>변수가 0인 경우에 기대되는 <emphasis effect="italics">y</emphasis>의 평균값을 알려 줍니다.

segments.source: However, in many scenarios it may not make sense to have the <emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis>-variable equal zero, and in these cases, the intercept does not have any meaning in the context of the problem.
segments.translation: 그러나 많은 상황에서 <emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis> 변수가 0이 되는 것은 타당하지 않을 수 있으며, 이러한 경우 절편은 문제의 맥락에서 아무런 의미를 갖지 않습니다.

segments.source: In other examples, the <emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis>-value of zero is outside the range of the <emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis>-data that was collected.
segments.translation: 또 다른 예에서는 <emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis> 값 0이 수집된 <emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis> 데이터의 범위를 벗어나 있습니다.

segments.source: In this case, we should not assign any interpretation to the <emphasis effect="italics">y</emphasis>-intercept.
segments.translation: 이러한 경우에는 <emphasis effect="italics">y</emphasis>절편에 어떠한 해석도 부여해서는 안 됩니다.

segments.source: In the previous example, the range of data collected for the <emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis>-variable was from $49 to $153 spent per month on advertising.
segments.translation: 앞의 예에서 <emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis> 변수에 대해 수집된 데이터의 범위는 월 광고비 지출 49달러에서 153달러까지였습니다.

segments.source: Since this interval does not include an <emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis>-value of zero, we would not provide any interpretation for the intercept.
segments.translation: 이 구간에는 <emphasis effect="italics">x</emphasis> 값 0이 포함되지 않으므로 절편에 대해서는 어떠한 해석도 제시하지 않습니다.

segments.source: Once a correlation has been deemed significant, a linear regression model is developed.
segments.translation: 상관관계가 유의한 것으로 판단되면 선형 회귀 모형을 개발합니다.

segments.source: The goal in the regression analysis is to determine the coefficients <emphasis effect="italics">a</emphasis> and <emphasis effect="italics">b</emphasis> in the following regression equation: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi></math>.
segments.translation: 회귀분석의 목표는 다음 회귀방정식의 계수 <emphasis effect="italics">a</emphasis>와 <emphasis effect="italics">b</emphasis>를 구하는 것입니다. <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi></math>.

segments.source: Typically some technology, such as Excel, R statistical tool, or a calculator, is used to generate the coefficients <emphasis effect="italics" xmlns="http://cnx.rice.edu/cnxml">a</emphasis> and <emphasis effect="italics">b</emphasis> since manual calculations are cumbersome.
segments.translation: 수작업 계산은 번거롭기 때문에 일반적으로 Excel, R 통계 도구, 계산기 등의 기술을 사용하여 계수 <emphasis effect="italics" xmlns="http://cnx.rice.edu/cnxml">a</emphasis>와 <emphasis effect="italics">b</emphasis>를 산출합니다.

segments.source: an equation of the form <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi></math> that provides the best-fit straight line to the (<emphasis effect="italics" xmlns="http://cnx.rice.edu/cnxml">x, y</emphasis>) data points
segments.translation: (<emphasis effect="italics" xmlns="http://cnx.rice.edu/cnxml">x, y</emphasis>) 데이터 점들에 가장 잘 맞는 직선을 제공하는 <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi></math> 형태의 방정식
